question: Can twenty sealed parents complete the unchanged native mesh contract when every parent is generated exactly once in a fresh E1 process?
method: Read only the sealed C13-C15 parent manifest. Launch exactly twenty sequential fresh E1 workers, each bound to one index and parent ID and allowed one native mesh/sanitation plus a train-only preview. Enforce an independent 2-GiB runner-plus-active-worker process-tree RSS limit per parent. Never read or reuse V1/V1R/V1R2 assets.
baseline: V1R2 single-process batching accumulated native/Open3D memory and correctly failed above 2 GiB; six cross-run comparisons retained identical topology and geometry identities while confirming OBJ byte equality is not a valid Open3D replay criterion.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable V1R3 batch: twenty sealed parents in fixed order, one fresh E1 child and one mesh per parent, per-parent 2-GiB process-tree RSS traces, ten train previews and zero validation previews; zero LiDAR, teacher, samples, training, models, C09/C10 or M-TARE; no failed-run reuse.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 批准 immediately after the exact V1R3 one-shot scope, cost, evidence and exclusions were displayed.

resource_contract.definition: For each parent, sum psutil RSS for the lightweight batch runner and its one active fresh E1 worker plus recursive descendants.
resource_contract.on_rss_exceed: SIGINT the active worker process group, mark parent and batch FAIL, seal without retry.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly twenty fixed-order workers launch once each; no retry or reselection.
Exactly twenty topology identities, meshes, sanitation audits, metrics and worker receipts pass.
Exactly ten train previews and zero validation previews are created.
Every parent process-tree peak RSS is <=2147483648 bytes, batch duration <=7200 seconds and result <=1073741824 bytes.
All downstream counters and failed-run read/reuse counts remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any authorization, tool, source seal, environment, identity, order, split or seed drift.
Any parent RSS breach, worker failure, missing receipt, mesh/sanitation failure, timeout, disk excess, validation preview or downstream operation.
Any retry, parent reselection, cross-run mesh selection, or V1/V1R/V1R2 asset read/reuse.
expected_evidence: Twenty one-shot worker logs, RSS traces/summaries, receipts, mesh assets, sanitation records and metrics.
Ten train-only maps, batch mesh manifest, summaries, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Twenty sequential fresh CPU workers in exact Cano E1; zero GPU, LiDAR, teacher or model.
